main.description: Lists actors following an entity AT-URI. No authentication is required; duplicate actor–entity relationships use the earliest createdAt, with URI ascending on ties. totalCount reports distinct relationships before cursor and limit. Only the returned page is hydrated: missing profile and organization sidecars are null, while lookup failures return errors rather than partial pages.

entity.description: Full AT-URI of the followed record using a DID authority; any target collection is accepted, and matching is by URI, not CID.

sortDirection.description: Sorts by representative follow createdAt and URI; defaults to desc.

limit.description: Maximum relationships per page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor bound to sortDirection; keep the other query parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The entity AT-URI or another query parameter is invalid.

entityFollowerView.description: The follower actor and the raw entity-follow record representing its relationship.

totalCount.description: Count of distinct actor–entity relationships after duplicate records are collapsed, before cursor and limit are applied.

cursor.description: Next-page cursor; omitted when no more results are available.
